responsibility: Generated implementation file for LoongArch ISA-evolution metadata. It defines the backend tables that associate each evolution feature with its OPTION_MASK_ISA_* bit, its predefined C macro spelling, and the major/minor ISA version where the feature was introduced, allowing the rest of the target to query feature masks and expose stable feature-version information.
same_name_distinction: Unlike loongarch-evolution.h, which declares the evolution feature enum, cpucfg discovery mapping, condition macros, and extern interfaces, this generated source file contains the concrete arrays that map each evolution feature to its option-mask bit, predefined macro name, and ISA version numbers.
